name: inquiry-resolution-plan

label_policy.author: designer; vocabulary and frozen rows adopted by the product owner on 2026-09-20 (DEV/CALIBRATION — never a holdout)
label_policy.steps: CLOSES = an authority allowed to close the need; PRECONDITION = must be read before it; CONTEXT = read, never closes. A fallback to the seller is not a step.
label_policy.expected_terminal: where the need ends once every system step the CURRENT registry offers has run on snapshot S0's knowledge — listing detail acquisition included, no image reader, no procedure executor, today's order connectors. Not the immediate next step: a need whose listing detail was never read is 'acquire first' now and ends here after it.
label_policy.pending: PENDING_ADJUDICATION rows carry the proposal and alternatives and are excluded from every score until the product owner decides

holds: real inquiry id prefixes and the designer's plan labels; no customer or seller text

withdrawn.why: v2 filed an answer known to sit in the listing's detail pictures under NOT_SUPPORTED — the same word as a field a channel does not provide. The S1 diagnostic showed the layer cannot tell such a possible gap from the seller's knowledge being short, so the vocabulary gained UNREADABLE_SOURCE and the gold had to name it.
